endpoints.desc: Executes raw CEL (cluaiz Execution Language) scripts natively for dynamic agentic logic and algorithmic workflows.

params.name: script
params.desc: The raw CEL script payload to execute.

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {"script": "return 42;"}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/cel/execute', json=payload)
print(res.json())

endpoints.desc: Dynamic ecosystem execution. Directly calls an exposed FFI function inside a component (e.g. extension, plugin).

params.name: params
params.desc: JSON parameters payload passed directly to the component function.

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {"params": {"query": "example search", "limit": 10}}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/execute/plugin_name/function_name', json=payload)
print(res.json())
